# Blog Website

A minimalist blog application built with Flask and SQLite. Users can register, log in, browse, search and sort blogs, and create, edit, and delete their own posts.

## Requirements

- Python 3.11 or newer

## Setup (Windows PowerShell)

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

macOS/Linux: `source .venv/bin/activate` instead of the activate script above.

## Run

```powershell
$env:FLASK_DEBUG = "1"        # development only; or set SECRET_KEY instead
python run.py                 # http://127.0.0.1:5000
```

This is a Python app: there is no `npm start`.

For anything other than local development, set a strong `SECRET_KEY` and leave `FLASK_DEBUG` unset. The app refuses to start without a `SECRET_KEY` unless debug is on.

| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `SECRET_KEY` | Signs session cookies. Required outside debug mode. | none |
| `FLASK_DEBUG` | `1` enables Flask debug mode (development only). | off |
| `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE` | `1` marks the session cookie HTTPS-only. Set in production behind HTTPS. | off |

The SQLite database is created automatically at `instance/blog.db` on first start. To create the tables explicitly: `flask --app run init-db`.

## Test

```powershell
pytest
```

## Behavior notes

- Sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity. Pages that contain a form send a keep-alive request every 5 minutes so long posts are not lost.
- Usernames: 3-30 characters from letters, digits, `_`, `.`, `-`. Passwords: 8-128 characters.
- Blog title up to 150 characters; content up to 10,000 characters (plain text).
- Search and sort are case-insensitive for ASCII letters only.

## Known limitations

No login rate limiting, no pagination, no email verification or password reset, and session cookies cannot be revoked server-side before they expire.
